shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/side view
paired or repeated figures in a row
animal motif (feline face in A, rams in B)
vertical element dividing the field (banner/pole in A, tree in B)
justification: Both show human figures in profile arranged in a row alongside a tall vertical element (a banner in A, a tree in B) and both include animal imagery, but these are generic correspondences. A is a symmetrical, heavily ornamented pair of costumed figures mirrored about a central axis with rosettes, headdresses and geometric bands, while B is an asymmetrical processional file of men leading horned rams past a tree, rendered naturalistically with no ornament-driven symmetry.
